content: Better Auth core schema (packages/core/src/db/get-tables.ts, main): user = name(req), email(req,unique), emailVerified(boolean req default false, not input), image, createdAt/updatedAt. session = expiresAt, token(unique), createdAt, updatedAt, ipAddress, userAgent, userId(FK cascade indexed). account = accountId, providerId, userId(FK cascade indexed), accessToken/refreshToken/idToken/accessTokenExpiresAt/refreshTokenExpiresAt/scope/password (never returned), createdAt, updatedAt. verification = identifier(indexed), value, expiresAt, createdAt, updatedAt. FKs reference schema key 'user' not custom modelName (issue #8111). modelName renames table; fields renames columns (type inference keeps original names); advanced.database.generateId = false|serial|uuid|function; CLI generate (not migrate) for non-Kysely adapters.
